subject: Data anchoring evidence and PrivateLink operator appendix
messages:
From: Emma Shaw <emma.shaw@medsecure.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.example.com
Cc: procurement@medsecure.com
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 14:12:00 +0000
Subject: Residency evidence request for EU-only pilot (PrivateLink)

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the call this morning. As we discussed, MedSecure needs a compact evidence package to confirm that the PrivateLink pilot will be EU-only for production data and that operator access is limited to EU-resident operators. Procurement would like the packet to cover the following items so we can move to contracting: 

- A short statement confirming the data plane and keystore are hosted in the EU and will not egress to non-EU regions.
- PrivateLink topology diagram showing peering location(s) and subnet mapping.
- Keystore/operator roster (roles + home region) for any personnel or partner operators who may perform live ops on the tenant.
- Signed residency affidavit and the SIG/CAIQ pointers we can attach to our vendor assessment.

Would you be able to provide those artifacts (or a timeframe) by COB Monday (2026-05-10)? Our security team is ready to accept a narrow, operator-scoped roster rather than a full SOC2 package if that speeds things up.

Appreciate it — Emma
Emma Shaw
Senior Vendor Security Manager
MedSecure Health
From: markus_klein@redwood.example.com
To: Emma Shaw <emma.shaw@medsecure.com>
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.example.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.example.com
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 15:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Residency evidence request for EU-only pilot (PrivateLink)

Hi Emma — thanks for the clear list. Short answer: yes, we can provide a compact evidence bundle suitable for procurement review.

Plan: I'll assemble a short cover note + the three artifacts you listed. Irene — can you pull the PrivateLink topology and confirm the exact AZ/subnet endpoints and peering IPs we can include? Grace — can you export the keystore operator roster (limited to people and partner agents who have possible egress or keystore access) and a short note on how KMS splits are enforced?

Irene/Grace — if we can get a draft by EOD Thursday (2026-05-07) I will package, sign the residency affidavit, and send to MedSecure on Friday morning. If there are any items that must remain redacted for security reasons we should list them and provide an alternate attestation language.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Director, Field Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: irene_choi@redwood.example.com
To: markus_klein@redwood.example.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.example.com
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 15:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Residency evidence request for EU-only pilot (PrivateLink)

Markus — looping in details here. Quick clarifications and ETA: 

1) PrivateLink topology: we have a draft peering diagram that maps the customer's VPC to our EU-hosted peering endpoints (eu-west-1a/b). I can generate a sanitized PDF that removes internal hostnames but keeps AZ and CIDR ranges. Target: 2026-05-07 18:00 UTC.

2) Keystore operator roster: our ops roster currently lists 6 potential operator roles and 2 third-party peering engineers (contractor partners). We can produce a CSV with: name (redacted to initials if needed), role, home region, and last training date. For MedSecure we should aim to surface region (EU / non-EU) rather than exact address. Target: 2026-05-07 18:00 UTC.

3) KMS split & controls: short note describing customer-keystore separation: tenant keys are customer-owned; Redwood holds a wrapped shard for availability in EU only. I will include the CAIQ/SIG sections that describe key custody and operator access controls.

4) Residency affidavit: Markus — do you want Legal to sign or will Security sign? If Legal needs to be involved, we should note that may push the timeline 24–48 hours.

I can proceed with sanitized artifacts; please confirm redaction level for roster (initials vs full names).

Irene Choi
Principal Security Architect
Redwood Inference

From: markus_klein@redwood.example.com
To: Emma Shaw <emma.shaw@medsecure.com>
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.example.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.example.com
Date: Wed, 6 May 2026 09:10:00 +0000
Subject: Residency evidence packet for EU-only PrivateLink pilot — MedSecure (attachments)

Emma — attaching the compact packet for your procurement/security review. Summary below, and attachments are listed as stubs at the bottom. If anything needs to be redacted or adjusted, let me know and we will provide the alternate attestation language you mentioned on the call.

Summary (short):
- Data plane and keystore: Confirmed EU-only. Production tenant will be pinned to eu-west-1; no automated cross-region failover to non-EU will be enabled for the tenant. Keystore shards are stored and accessible only from EU-resident operator roles unless you request an alternate configuration.
- PrivateLink topology: sanitized PDF showing peering endpoints (eu-west-1a/b), peering subnets, and the ingress-egress CIDR mappings.
- Keystore operator roster: CSV contains operator role, region (EU / non-EU), and last training date. We have redacted personal addresses and replaced full names with initials for third-party contractors; internal EU-resident operators are listed by full name.
- SIG/CAIQ pointers: included references (document IDs) for the sections that map to key custody and operator access controls.

Next steps:
- If this completes your intake, Procurement can attach the residency_affidavit_signed.pdf to the SOW and we can proceed to DocuSign.
- If Legal signature is required on the affidavit we can escalate; please advise.

Attachments (stubs):
- privatelink_topology_v1.pdf (PDF, sanitized diagram)
- keystore_operator_roster.csv (CSV, initials for contractors)
- residency_affidavit_signed.pdf (PDF, signed by Redwood Security)

Delivery links (for transfer): https://drive.redwood.example.com/teams/attestations/medsecure-privatelink
DocuSign (residency affidavit): https://docusign.com/link/residency-affidavit/ABC12345

Regards,
Markus Klein
Director, Field Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
